entities.name: Karrthus
entities.description: A dragon called the Tyrant of Jund, encountered by Ajani Goldmane on his first planeswalk, later mindwiped by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Leonin planeswalker who encountered Karrthus on his first planeswalk.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who fooled Karrthus to spare Ajani's life.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker who captured and brainwashed Karrthus.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Plane against which the dragons were used.

entities.name: Obelisk of Naya
entities.description: An obelisk wrested in the battle for Naya.

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol fools Karrthus into thinking Ajani was his kill to spare the leonin's life.
events.quote: Sarkhan Vol fooled Karrthus into thinking that Ajani was his kill in order to spare the leonin's life.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas captures Karrthus and four smaller dragons, mindwipes and brainwashes them, then hands them to Sarkhan for the battle for Naya.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas captured Karrthus, along with four other, smaller dragons, mindwiped them all and brainwashed them

relations.note: Bolas captured and brainwashed Karrthus into serving.
relations.quote: brainwashed them into serving Sarkhan and him
